absent: Probe, removal, configuration update work, feature negotiation, and transport setup beyond the fragments shown.
Tag set sizing, queue mapping, interrupt affinity, polling configuration, and disk registration.
Complete zone report iteration, remaining zone type mappings, and zoned limit initialization beyond the truncated portion.
Layout specific ring implementations for split, packed, and in order variants behind the dispatch selection.
Error logging, sysfs attributes, power management, and suspend resume handling.
Discard limits, write zeroes limits, and secure erase capability advertisement.

findings.text: Partition bits constant carries value four. Queue name length constant carries value sixteen and sizes per queue names. Maximum discard segments constant carries value two hundred fifty six.
Maximum scatter gather elements constant carries value thirty two thousand seven hundred sixty eight.
Two build alternatives exist for inline scatterlist capacity, one selecting none inline and another selecting two inline, controlling how much chaining storage is embedded in each request.
Feature index mapping splits an integer into word selector by shifting right six and bit selector by masking low six bits, addressing an array of sixty four bit words.
Per queue state bundles a virtqueue reference with a spin lock and a fixed length character name, with cache line alignment to avoid sharing between queues.

Device state holds a mutex guarding late access after removal, a device pointer, a disk pointer, a tag set, a configuration work item, an index, queue counts and per type counts, a queue vector pointer, and a zone length in sectors.

Request private data holds an output header, a variable length input trailer, a length field, a scatter table, and trailing inline scatter entries. The input trailer is either a single status byte or an extended zone append pairing of a sector value with a trailing status byte.

Device status translation maps success to success, unsupported operation to not supported, two distinct zone resource conditions to matching zone resource outcomes, and all other values including input output error and unaligned write pointer to generic input output error.
Hardware context to queue translation obtains device state from the queue common data then indexes the queue vector by the context queue number.

Submission descriptor assembly always starts with the output header, appends payload in the direction implied by the request type when present, and ends with the variable length input trailer, issued atomically with the request as cookie.
Scatter array submission interface accepts separate output and input counts plus opaque data and allocation flags, totals chained entries across arrays, then forwards to the internal add path.
Generic queue handles are converted to internal ring state via container linkage before dispatch to layout specific add logic.

Queue operations dispatch across four layout modes covering split and packed each in normal and in order variants, with any other value treated as fatal programming error. Both value returning and void forms share this selection.

Byte order conversion for thirty two and sixty four bit values selects little endian when the modern version feature is negotiated or the legacy host is little endian, otherwise big endian, with symmetric helpers for each direction.
Feature presence checks first validate the bit position then test the corresponding word in the device feature array, with an additional driver offered check for transport independent bits.
Bit range validation fails the build for constant out of range indices and emits a one time warning with a false result for runtime out of range indices, accepting all in range values.

Command preparation assigns priority for every operation then maps block operations to device types including read, write, flush, discard, write zeroes with optional unmap control, secure erase, and several zone management kinds. Zone append uses an extended input trailer while an internal driver operation bypasses preparation. Unknown operations and zone management without zone support are rejected.

Discard style payload construction allocates one descriptor per segment atomically, fills a single range directly when the queue allows only one segment, otherwise walks constituent bios to fill sector and length per entry, attaches the buffer as special payload, and warns if the filled count differs from expected.

Data mapping skips empty requests, otherwise chains inline storage with additional table pages sized by physical segment count and records the mapped entry count. Unmapping releases chained tables only when segments exist. Cleanup frees special payload buffers when flagged.
Completion status is read as the final byte of the variable length input area, allowing a shared accessor for normal and extended zone append trailers.

Request finalization releases mappings and command resources, writes back the device assigned sector for zone append operations using endian conversion, then ends the block request with translated status.

Interrupt side completion locks the per queue state, suppresses callbacks, drains all available buffers completing each unless a fake timeout is indicated, re arms callbacks with a poll check for races, restarts stopped hardware queues when progress occurred, then releases the lock.
Buffer retrieval without context delegates to a context capable variant with no context requested, which resolves internal ring state and dispatches to layout specific retrieval.

Callback control disables notifications unconditionally, prepares re enabling by clearing a triggered flag and delegating, then polls for new used entries since the recorded index. Polling short circuits on broken state and orders memory according to barrier strength before delegating.

Single submission prepares the command and mapping, starts the block request, then under the queue lock adds descriptors. Add failure triggers a kick, stops the hardware queue only on space exhaustion, releases mappings, and translates the error. Success kicks only on last batch element when the transport requests it, notifying outside the lock.

Batch submission groups consecutive requests by destination queue, flushing the accumulated list whenever the queue changes and once at the end, separating preparation failures for requeue. Per queue flushing holds the lock while adding each entry, requeues individual add failures with cleanup, then performs a single deferred kick decision with notification outside the lock. A commit hook performs the same deferred kick for one hardware context.

Kick preparation delegates to layout logic to decide whether notification is needed. Notification fails fast on broken state, otherwise invokes the transport notify callback and marks broken on failure. Combined kick notifies only when preparation requests it and reports success when no notification was needed.
Memory ordering selects a lighter virt barrier when weak barriers are allowed and a full barrier otherwise.

Zone report buffer sizing caps the requested zone count by device capacity divided by zone length, adds header plus per zone descriptors, further caps by hardware sector and segment limits, then retries halving allocations until success or below header size. Submission uses an internal read operation with type and sector set, maps the buffer, executes synchronously, and translates status. Parsing derives start, length clipped at capacity, capacity, write pointer, and maps three device zone types to block zone types.

A device mutex serializes any path that may execute after removal clears the device pointer. Block multiqueue, queue processing, and attribute paths are shut down before that clearing and therefore operate without this mutex.

Each virtqueue has its own spin lock guarding descriptor add, kick preparation, and completion draining. Submission and completion use interrupt saving variants while the commit hook uses interrupt disabling without explicit flag save, with notification performed after unlock.

Space exhaustion stops the hardware queue for retry while memory exhaustion leaves it running to avoid stalling on global shortage. Broken queue state suppresses further polling and notification. Status byte must remain last in the extended zone append trailer for the shared accessor to stay correct. Atomic allocation failures in setup and add paths must unwind mappings and special payloads.

File scope storage includes two unsigned integers for queue counts, one integer for major number, and one workqueue pointer. Device state additionally stores total queue count and per type queue counts.

Public queue primitives exposed to drivers include scatter submission, buffer retrieval with and without context, callback suppression and re arming with preparation and polling helpers, and kick preparation plus notification plus combined kick.

Block request lifecycle progresses from command setup and data mapping through start, locked enqueue, conditional notify, interrupt driven completion, mapping release and status translation to termination, with preparation or enqueue failures diverting to cleanup plus requeue or error return without completion.
